_doc.zh: 语音合成用到的模型和依赖：来源、固定的版本、许可、读到的原文条款、每个下载文件的 sha256。模型文件不进 git；由 `uv run --extra model python -m soma_tts.fetch --state <目录>` 下载到状态目录并逐个校验。许可证据是 2026-10-13 打开各来源读到的。
_doc.en: The models and dependencies of speech synthesis: source, pinned version, licence, the clause as read, and the sha256 of every downloaded file. Model files are not in git; `uv run --extra model python -m soma_tts.fetch --state <dir>` downloads them into the state directory and verifies each one. The licence evidence is what was read at each source on 2026-10-13.

evidence.localUse: model card: "With Apache-licensed weights, Kokoro can be deployed anywhere from production environments to personal projects."
evidence.generatedAudio: The model card and the Apache License 2.0 place no condition on the model's output; the card says: "This is an Apache-licensed model, and Kokoro has been deployed in numerous projects and commercial APIs. We welcome the deployment of the model in real use cases." Apache-2.0 section 2 (the grant, for the weights themselves): "2. Grant of Copyright License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this License, each Contributor hereby grants to You a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright license to reproduce, prepare Derivative Works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense, and distribute the Work and such Derivative Works in Source or Object form."
evidence.trainingData: model card: "Kokoro was trained exclusively on permissive/non-copyrighted audio data and IPA phoneme labels." It lists public-domain audio, Apache/MIT audio, synthetic audio from closed TTS models of large providers, and CC BY audio (Koniwa `tnc`, CC BY 3.0; SIWIS, CC BY 4.0).

evidence.localUse: model card: "Kokoro is an open-weight series of small but powerful TTS models." and "This Apache licensed model ..."
evidence.generatedAudio: The model card and the Apache License 2.0 place no condition on the model's output. Apache-2.0 section 2 (the grant, for the weights themselves): "2. Grant of Copyright License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this License, each Contributor hereby grants to You a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright license to reproduce, prepare Derivative Works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense, and distribute the Work and such Derivative Works in Source or Object form."
evidence.trainingData: model card: "This model is the result of a short training run that added 100 Chinese speakers from a professional dataset. The Chinese data was freely and permissively granted to us by LongMaoData, a professional dataset company." It also names 3 hours of crowdsourced synthetic English.

why.zh: misaki[en] 的可选兜底（词典外的英文单词）。本服务不安装它（pyproject 里的 exclude-dependencies），词典外的单词改用自己的拼读规则，并在返回里的 warnings 写明。
why.en: The optional fallback of misaki[en] for out-of-dictionary English words. This service does not install it (exclude-dependencies in pyproject); such words go through the service's own letter-to-sound rules and are listed under `warnings` in the reply.

why.zh: 同上，只被 espeak 兜底使用。
why.en: As above; only used by the espeak fallback.

verdict.zh: 没有采用。仓库的 README 写着开发已迁到 OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl，后者的 COPYING 是 GNU GPL v3；它内嵌 espeak-ng 做音素化（README："embeds espeak-ng for phonemization"）。各声音的许可不一。
verdict.en: Not chosen. The repository's README says development has moved to OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl, whose COPYING is the GNU GPL v3; it embeds espeak-ng for phonemization (README: "embeds espeak-ng for phonemization"). Voices carry various licences.

verdict.zh: 没有采用。LICENSE 是 MIT（README："free for both commercial and non-commercial use"）。但依赖很重且钉死旧版本（transformers==4.27.4、librosa==0.9.1、mecab、unidic 等），没有在这台机器上试装；接口不返回音素时长。
verdict.en: Not chosen. The LICENSE is MIT (README: "free for both commercial and non-commercial use"). Its dependencies are heavy and pinned to old versions (transformers==4.27.4, librosa==0.9.1, mecab, unidic and more); it was not installed on this machine, and its interface returns no phoneme durations.
